fixed.climate: none of its own: an enclosed dream-only falling space (geography.json LOC-descent-shaft 'cool, still dream-air')

dream_design.flora: carved and painted vine, lily and poppy tendrils climb the shaft walls between the cupboards and book-shelves, winding downward into the dark; pale roots curl out of the earth between the shelves
dream_design.ornament_cues: the fading glow above is a circular halo roundel of warm light, the one bright disc in the frame; shelf edges and picture frames carry whiplash mouldings and gilt inlay; the shaft's walls curve in organic spirals, not straight shafts (form belongs to architecture; the marmalade jar and hand props stay 1862, WR-009)
dream_design.palette: dusty rose, faded lilac and ivory in the glow, gilt glints on mouldings, sinking into blue-black below
dream_design.seasonal_guard: no season in the shaft; carved flora only, so no season clash
dream_design.reason: Cupboards, book-shelves, maps and pictures and the dark are explicit (ch001-p06). Carving, the roundel glow and palette are designed to WR-010 and SUP-008.

fixed.dream_growth: Grows from the hot bank and the shade of the hedge burrow. As Alice's eyes close against the 2 pm glare, the bright field narrows to a shaft; the last warm daylight fades to a dim glow above her, and the air turns cool and still like the shade under the hedge. There is no weather, sky or wind in the shaft: its only 'time' is the afternoon she is sleeping through.

source.quote: First, she tried to look down and make out what she was coming to, but it was too dark to see anything

fixed.reason: Darkness below is explicit (ch001-p06). The cool air follows geography.json. How the shaft grows from the waking afternoon is designed per ruling 5.2 A and SUP-008 (anxiety-dream fall, not a real shaft).

states.diegetic_daylight: none; a fading warm glow high above, the shelves and pictures dimly readable, and blackness below
states.conditions: still, cool, faintly dusty air; Alice drifts slowly rather than plummeting, her dress and hair lifting gently

source.quote: it was too dark to see anything; then she looked at the sides of the well, and noticed that they were filled with cupboards and book-shelves

also_seen.quote: She felt that she was dozing off

states.reason: Darkness is explicit (ch001-p06). The shelves must stay readable while the depths stay black, so a dim upper glow is designed. The waking clock is designed from the dream's start time: Alice dozes off right after the 14:10 chase (ev0002 follows ev0001 'continuous', story_timeline). time_of_day is the waking-clock phase; no daylight reaches the shaft.
